zh.name: 值得互相问的问题卡
zh.summary: 用一组可直接拿来问的问题推动交流，每页保持明确的问题主角和卡片形态。
zh.useWhen: 问题本身是可用产物；区别于有标准答案的测试和引导填写的工作表。
zh.instructions: 交流情境、问题顺序、隐私边界与卡片素材
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Conversation Question Cards
en.summary: Create an Instagram quiz carousel using the conversation question cards structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the conversation question cards format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

imageCues: 红字直接落在摄影封面，内页真实圆角卡片上的居中红色小型大写问题，字体约36–46px，桌放与手持卡变化
卡面正对相机，允许跳过的短句保留
